type.name: AccelerationStructureLevel
type.doc: Enumeration for the level of an acceleration structure in raytracing.

value.name: TopLevel
value.doc: Top-level acceleration structure, which contains instances of bottom-level structures.

value.name: BottomLevel
value.doc: Bottom-level acceleration structure, which contains geometry data such as triangles or AABBs.

type.name: AccelerationStructureDesc
type.doc: Structure describing the properties of an acceleration structure.

member.name: level
member.doc: The level of the acceleration structure (top-level or bottom-level).

member.name: offset
member.doc: The offset in bytes from the start of the buffer where the acceleration structure is located.

member.name: size
member.doc: The size of the acceleration structure in bytes.

handle.name: AccelerationStructure
handle.doc: Handle for an acceleration structure used in raytracing.

func.name: Supported
func.doc: Checks if raytracing is supported on the current device.

ret.name: supported
ret.doc: true if raytracing is supported, false otherwise.

func.name: CreateAccelerationStructure
func.doc: Creates an acceleration structure based on the provided description.

arg.name: buffer
arg.doc: The buffer to write the acceleration structure data to.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: The description of the acceleration structure to create.

func.name: GetGPUAddress
func.doc: Retrieves the GPU address of the acceleration structure.

ret.name: gpu_address
ret.doc: The GPU address of the acceleration structure.
